title: Fix an off-by-one bug in a sum function
task: The file sum.js in the current directory has a bug: its loop skips the last element. Fix the bug so that sum([1,2,3]) returns 6 and sum([]) returns 0. Do not change the function name or its signature. Leave the file runnable with node.

llmReview.criteria: The bug is genuinely fixed (the loop covers the final element), the public interface is unchanged, and no unrelated behaviour was broken.
